backend/main.mo: Motoko backend providing authorization, user profiles, mark submission, validation, and student data access control.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping features to related files, components, tests, and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Collection of one-line summaries for key frontend React and Android wrapper files.
frontend/ANDROID_APK_BUILD.md: Guide explaining prerequisites and steps to build debug and release Android APKs using Capacitor.
frontend/android/.gitignore: Gitignore file specifying generated, build, IDE, keystore, and Android-specific artifacts to exclude.
frontend/android/app/build.gradle: Android app module Gradle config defining SDK versions, build types, signing, dependencies, and Capacitor setup.
frontend/android/app/src/main/AndroidMan: Android manifest configuring app metadata, main activity, deep link for Internet Identity, provider paths, and permissions.
frontend/android/app/src/main/java/com/o: MainActivity extending Capacitor's BridgeActivity with default onCreate behavior.
frontend/android/app/src/main/res/values: Resource file defining app name, title, package name, and custom URL scheme strings.
frontend/android/app/src/main/res/xml/fi: FileProvider path configuration enabling access to cache and external files.
frontend/android/build.gradle: Top-level Gradle build script with repositories, Android plugin versions, and clean task.
frontend/android/gradle.properties: Project Gradle settings including JVM args, AndroidX config, architectures, and Hermes flags.
frontend/android/keystore/README.md: Notes about release signing and guidance to avoid committing keystore files.
frontend/android/variables.gradle: Centralized version variables for SDK, AndroidX, Cordova, and testing dependencies.
frontend/capacitor.config.ts: Capacitor configuration defining app identifiers, build settings, and Internet Identity navigation allowlist.
frontend/index.css: Defines Tailwind layers and CSS variables for light and dark themes, applying base colors and global styles.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point that mounts the React app and loads main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main app component handling authentication, splash screen, navigation, and view rendering.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Login/logout button managing Internet Identity authentication with UI feedback and error handling.
frontend/src/components/auth/ProfileSetu: Dialog for entering and saving a user's name when creating their profile.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: App layout component providing header, navigation, main content area, and footer.
frontend/src/components/SplashScreen.tsx: Animated splash screen that fades out and triggers continuation after a delay.
frontend/src/features/marks/MarksEntrySc: UI for entering, validating, and saving student marks with dynamic loading and error handling.
frontend/src/features/results/SessionRes: Displays final session results, computing weighted subject breakdowns per student.
frontend/src/features/results/StudentRes: Displays a student's final subject results with totals and explains the mark calculation method.
frontend/src/features/sessions/SessionsS: Manages academic sessions, allowing users to create, list, and select stored sessions.
frontend/src/features/students/StudentsS: Handles student management per session, including adding students and selecting one for mark entry.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to the user's identity and refreshes dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication state, login/logout handling, and identity persistence.
frontend/src/hooks/useMarks.ts: Fetches and submits raw student marks and invalidates related queries on updates.
frontend/src/hooks/useResults.ts: Retrieves final subject results for a student and full session reports via the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useUserProfile.ts: Fetches, saves, and retrieves the user's profile and role from the backend.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration defining theme variables, light/dark styles, and utility layers.
frontend/src/lib/marksConstants.ts: Defines subject and assessment metadata and helpers to resolve full marks and subject labels.
frontend/src/lib/marksValidation.ts: Validates mark input strings, enforcing numeric, non-negative, whole-number values within full-mark limits.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with React Query and Internet Identity providers.
frontend/src/utils/capacitorPlatform.ts: Provides helpers to detect Capacitor native environment and Android WebView context.
frontend/src/utils/iiLoginWebViewShim.ts: Implements a Capacitor Android WebView Internet Identity login shim using external browser redirects and deep-link callbacks.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides utilities for reading, storing, and clearing URL and session parameters, supporting hash-based routing.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures TailwindCSS themes, colors, breakpoints, animations, and plugins.
project_state.json: Stores project metadata, features, and requirements for the Android APK build effort.
